title: Historical Overload Enchantments
provenance: Community wiki reference supplied by n00b on 2026-10-01. Names and effect text are preserved as supplied. NOT screenshot-verified. Display-only: Toon Forge and the optimizer do not read this file (their overloads live in ../data/overloads.json).
data_notes: Lesser/Greater are separate enchantment items. Keep their effects separate.
Companion marks use Rank 1/Rank 2 and work on companions, not players.
Some campaign/event overloads have one listed version rather than a Lesser/Greater pair.
Preserve the names and effect text below. Do not invent versions or effects.
Enchantment effects and item availability may have changed between game updates. Treat this as a historical reference, not a guarantee of current availability.

categories.trigger: 25% chance; can trigger once every 60 seconds

entries.name: Black Dragon Glyph
entries.lesser_effect: Gain 400 Critical Strike for 20 seconds. Damaging powers deal an additional 600 Acid damage over 6 seconds; this damage can stack up to 3 times.
entries.greater_effect: Gain 800 Critical Strike for 20 seconds. Damaging powers deal an additional 900 Acid damage over 6 seconds; this damage can stack up to 3 times.

entries.name: Blue Dragon Glyph
entries.lesser_effect: Gain 400 Defense for 20 seconds. Targets that hit you take 400 Lightning damage.
entries.greater_effect: Gain 800 Defense for 20 seconds. Targets that hit you take 600 Lightning damage.

entries.name: Green Dragon Glyph
entries.lesser_effect: Gain 400 Deflect for 20 seconds. Deal 200 Poison damage every 2 seconds to foes within 30 feet. When the effect ends, foes within 30 feet take 2,000 Poison damage.
entries.greater_effect: Gain 800 Deflect for 20 seconds. Deal 300 Poison damage every 2 seconds to foes within 30 feet. When the effect ends, foes within 30 feet take 3,000 Poison damage.

entries.name: Red Dragon Glyph
entries.lesser_effect: Gain 400 Armor Penetration for 20 seconds. Damaging powers deal an additional 400 Fire damage.
entries.greater_effect: Gain 800 Armor Penetration for 20 seconds. Damaging powers deal an additional 600 Fire damage.

entries.name: White Dragon Glyph
entries.trigger_condition: When dealing damage or healing allies
entries.lesser_effect: Gain 400 Power for 20 seconds and increase outgoing healing by 7%.
entries.greater_effect: Gain 800 Power for 20 seconds and increase outgoing healing by 10%.
